'''Kirius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], serving in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was tasked with providing supplies to Imperial personnel.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Biography==
Stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] in between operations,<ref name="vaiken" /> over the course of the [[Galactic War]] Kirius was assigned to several worlds starting from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where she was accompanied by [[Private/Legends|Privates]] [[Guon]] and [[Hooll]].<ref name="corellia">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Coronet City Spaceport]]|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> Hooll later rejoined her on Ilum during the [[Battle of Ilum|Operation Dark Ice]].<ref name="Ilum">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref> 

After that, Sergeant Kirius was reassigned to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kantis]] and accompanied her to [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]<ref name="X">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Crag Outpost]]|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref> and later [[Makeb]], during the [[Conquest of Makeb|conqusest]] of the planet.<ref name="makeb">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Kirius appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor on the Imperial fleet and several planets.<ref name="TOR" />
